promise.line: And I cried and prayed and promised
stanza: Ah, she gave the most, took the least
And she even had the priest come to our home
And I cried and prayed and promised
That I'd leave the stuff alone

promise.line: I'll prolly die anonymous, I'll prolly die with promises
promise.linePrev: Paradise—I don't think I could find a way to make it on this earth
promise.lineNext: I'll prolly die walkin' back home from the candy house (Yeah)
